response.justification: The candidate is an accomplished senior full-stack/web engineer with strong software craftsmanship, but the role requires deep expertise in SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator performance analysis, GPU architecture, and hardware-software co-design — none of which appear in the resume. Aside from some low-latency systems work in DLang and minor embedded exposure, there is no evidence of hardware architecture, deep-learning workload optimization, or performance modeling at the silicon level, making this a fundamental domain mismatch for a Principal Performance Architect position.
strengths: 15+ years of software engineering experience, exceeding the years-of-experience requirement
Low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (DLang, async I/O, fibers) at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic
Strong engineering practices (TDD, CI/CD, open-source contributions, teaching/mentoring)
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling, GPU architecture, or hardware-level performance work
No deep-learning training/inference optimization or SIMD/MIMD architecture background
Career trajectory is web/full-stack product engineering, far from principal-level hardware architecture

key_factors.factor: General seniority and systems programming background
